name: Unreal AI PCG
description: PCG (Procedural Content Generation) tools for AI agents: list and inspect PCG graphs, and add, inspect and generate PCG components on actors in the editor world.

tools.name: pcg-list-graphs
tools.description: Lists every PCG graph (UPCGGraph) asset in the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them. Optionally filter by a content-path prefix.

tools.name: pcg-get-graph
tools.description: Inspects a single PCG graph asset (read-only) and reports its nodes.

tools.name: pcg-add-component
tools.description: Adds a UPCGComponent to a named actor in the active editor world, optionally bound to a PCG graph asset.

tools.name: pcg-get-component
tools.description: Inspects the UPCGComponent on a named actor in the active editor world (read-only): its bound graph and generation state.

tools.name: pcg-generate
tools.description: Triggers PCG generation (refresh) on the UPCGComponent of a named actor in the active editor world.

_comment: Install-catalog / compatibility manifest, shaped as ONE unreal-mcp-cli ExtensionDescriptor (cli/src/utils/extensions-catalog.ts in Unreal-MCP) so it is directly liftable into the shared extensions.catalog.json { schemaVersion, extensions[] }. 'version' mirrors the .uplugin VersionName (kept in sync by commands/bump-version.ps1). 'minCoreVersion' is the lowest Unreal-MCP core version this extension supports (refreshed by commands/update-core.ps1). 'enginePlugins' are the gating engine plugins (e.g. ['Niagara']) enabled in the .uproject alongside this extension — populated by commands/init -FeaturePlugin. 'tools' lists the contributed tool ids/descriptions. The install-extension resolver unions enginePlugins with the materialized .uplugin Plugins[].
